method: Wikipedia-first discovery; annual Taiwan table used directly. Global Wikipedia tables are either 2022/2023 or five-year intervals mixing historical and projected series. World Bank annual SP.POP.TOTL used as consistent exact-year fallback for other matched areas. Ratios represent surveyed learners/teachers/institutions per total population, not prevalence of all Japanese learners. Survey and population reference dates may differ within a year.
